build_stan_nschools_model: build a Python module to instantiate NSchools with model arguments for a hierarchical Bayesian schools model
format_data_to_stan: create a function that converts an xarray Dataset into a Stan-ready dictionary with 1-based indices
extract_data_from_stan: create a function that converts Stan MCMC samples into an xarray Dataset with inferred parameters
get_pars_nschools: create a function that returns the list of parameter names needed from the NSchools Stan inference
get_code_nschools: create a function that returns the Stan model code string for the hierarchical n-schools regression
